reasoning_content:
Docker runs. Internet reachable (401 from registry is expected). Let's check port availability and start the compose build. First set USER_ID/GROUP_ID. Let me check if a .env file exists or create one for compose var defaults. Dockerfile defaults them to 1001 if blank. Actually ARG USER_ID blank -> ENV USER_ID=$USER_ID -> blank, then ENV USER_ID=${USER_ID:-1001} sets 1001. Fine. But addgroup/adduser with blank? They use ENV USER_ID which is 1001 by then. OK.

Actually careful: addgroup --gid ${GROUP_ID} where GROUP_ID env = 1001. Good.

Let me check ports 3306/3000/3001/3002/3003 availability. And whether anything already running.

Let me start by building. This may take a long time. Let's do `docker compose up -d --build`. The 600s timeout may be hit. Let me build in background maybe. Better to run with nohup and poll.

Let me first check if images already built.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker images && echo "---containers---" && docker ps -a && echo "---ports---" && (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ':(3306|3000|3001|3002|3003)' || echo "ports free"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && docker images && echo \"---containers---\" && docker ps -a && echo \"---ports---\" && (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ':(3306|3000|3001|3002|3003)' || echo \"ports free\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check existing docker images/containers/ports"}
